stories.title: Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and align the proximity data contract with existing clinical trials models including distance, travel_time, origin (normalized user location), destination (trial site coordinates), units, and calculation metadata. Ensure null-safe handling, explicit unit standardization (miles, minutes), and compatibility with downstream facade formatting.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Time Calculation Logic
stories.description: Implement core proximity computation using Google Routes including user location normalization, multi-site iteration per trial, distance/time extraction, selection of primary site (nearest), and consistent unit normalization across all results.

stories.title: Proximity API Exposure via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate proximity outputs into evaluate_care_facade responses so each trial includes nearest-site distance and travel time, with optional full site list. Ensure formatting is conversationally readable and consistent with existing trial result structures.

stories.title: Unit and Edge Case Tests for Proximity Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating accuracy of distance/time calculations, unit consistency, nearest-site selection logic, handling of missing or invalid coordinates, and multi-site aggregation behavior.

stories.title: Google Routes Integration, Resilience, and Fallback Handling
stories.description: Implement Google Routes API integration including request construction, response parsing, timeout/retry handling, basic rate-limit protection, and graceful degradation when routing data is unavailable. Ensure system returns partial proximity results without blocking trial output.
